name: Golden Visa (10-year long-term residence)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a minimum capital of AED 2,000,000 in an accredited investment fund, or a commercial/industrial licence with capital of at least AED 2,000,000, or paying the government at least AED 250,000/year in taxes. Capital must not be loan-financed.
requirements.fix_path: Secure and commit the required capital.

value.note: as of 20 Feb 2026, only the total assessed property value matters — the prior 50%/AED 1,000,000 down-payment requirement was removed; ready, off-plan, and mortgaged properties all qualify

requirements.blocker_text: This requires property valued at a total of at least AED 2,000,000, assessed by the relevant land department, regardless of mortgage balance.
This requires an innovative/technical project valued at least AED 500,000 (per accredited auditor), plus a business-incubator or authority endorsement letter.
requirements.fix_path: Secure the qualifying project valuation and endorsement.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a basic monthly salary of at least AED 30,000, a valid employment contract, and an attested bachelor's degree classified level 1 or 2 by the Ministry of Education (doctors, scientists, inventors, creatives in culture and arts, executives, athletes, PhD holders, and specialists in priority scientific/engineering fields also qualify via profession-specific criteria).
requirements.fix_path: Negotiate a salary meeting the threshold, or qualify via profession-specific criteria.

evidence_required.document: Investment/property/salary evidence matching the applicable group

outcome.duration_length: 10 years (investor/talent groups) or 5 years (entrepreneur group), automatically renewable indefinitely while criteria are met
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: no minimum stay requirement; holders exempt from the standard 180-day absence rule that applies to shorter-term UAE residency

sources.title: Golden Visa - The Official Portal of the UAE Government

notes: CRITICAL STRUCTURAL FACT for this whole country's dataset: leads_to_pr and leads_to_citizenship are FALSE even for the UAE's flagship long-term residency product — the Golden Visa is renewable indefinitely but is genuinely a permanent CEILING, not a pipeline to citizenship, unlike every investor-adjacent route encoded elsewhere in this dataset (Portugal, Spain-formerly, France). This is the single most important structural fact to get right for the entire UAE country dataset. MAJOR STALE-DATA WARNING, one of the highest-confidence catches across the whole research pass: a viral claim of an 'AED 100,000 lifetime nomination Golden Visa' circulated in mid-2025 — the UAE's own ICP authority PUBLICLY DENIED this via state news agency WAM on 8 July 2025, stating the claims 'have no legal basis' and threatening legal action against parties spreading it; the consultancy involved (Rayad Group) retracted and apologized on 10 July 2025, admitting the AED 100,000 was their own service fee, not a government visa price. No such visa exists; the Golden Visa is NOT a lifetime visa and NOT citizenship-by-investment. LIVE POLICY CHANGE confirmed effective 20 February 2026: the real-estate route's 50%/AED 1,000,000 down-payment requirement was REMOVED — only total assessed property value matters now, a genuine liberalization many secondary sites still don't reflect. UNRESOLVED SOURCE CONFLICT flagged honestly: the real-estate group's duration is listed as 5 years on one official page and 10 years by most other sources — encoded here as matching the other investor/talent groups (10 years) as the more commonly corroborated figure, but this should be re-verified against the live ICP service page before being treated as fully settled.
